title: Stripe’s AI Strategy: Build More, Not Less

reader_summary.headline: Stripe builds more products with AI instead of cutting staff to grow faster.
reader_summary.overview: Stripe uses AI agents to write code and handle tasks, allowing engineers to act like founders. This approach lowers costs and enables the company to build new products that were previously impossible. Instead of reducing staff, Stripe hires more people to manage this increased software creation.

key_points.text: Stripe creates internal founder-like agencies so engineers can ship more products faster with less cost.
key_points.evidence_quote: If you want to ship more build faster, you have to create a founder-like agency inside your company.

key_points.text: Stripe is choosing to build more products instead of cutting staff, even as senior engineers become more powerful with AI.
key_points.evidence_quote: our belief is that it's just an opportunity to be a little cheeky, but to build everything.

key_points.text: Stripe uses AI agents called Minions to write code, which now creates about 30% of all code changes.
key_points.evidence_quote: Minions, we think of as, you know, the most, like one of our most important metrics internally is how many PRs and what percentage of our PRs are created by Minions.

key_points.text: Stripe uses stablecoins to let users transact in 150 countries, expanding access to the global software economy.
key_points.evidence_quote: Right now, you can be a striped user in, I can't remember what the exact number is, but around 60 countries in Fiat. But you can be a striped user in stablecoins in, I think, about 150 countries.
